scope.browser: Existing production component JS/CSS in headless fixture; 6x CPU throttle; 10 changed snapshots per sample; one warmup and five measured pages per size. Browser task/script metrics are not whole-extension CPU.
scope.browserOrder: Final candidate first, then isolated Native baseline matrix, then final browser baseline, then isolated Native candidate matrix. System-wide external load is not controlled.
scope.sourceHash: Benchmark bundle hashes exclude runtime-loaded media. Baseline media is fixed by its commit; candidate media is identified by productionSource hashes and remained unchanged across final measurements.
scope.native: Actual local Native Git operations and production HTML/CSP/JS, one sample per operation. Benchmark Node CPU includes Playwright transport and RSS/idle polling. No wall-time speed claim from this small matrix.
scope.intermediateNative: Overlapped other checks; retained for correctness/counter evidence and variability, not latency or CPU attribution.
scope.accessibility: Headless Chromium keyboard and AX tree with simulated official VS Code screen-reader mode class; no physical screen-reader session.
scope.focus: No visible Extension Development Host, OS window activation or forced reload.
